scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,MUNDO,WEB -c cyan,yellow,green "npm run dev -w @bar/api" "npm run dev -w @bar/server" "npm run dev -w @bar/web"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build -w @bar/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @bar/api && npm run test -w @bar/server && tsx --test tests/integration/*.test.ts && node --test tests/tools/*.test.mjs
scripts.assets:skins: node tools/import-skins.mjs && node tools/retarget-skins.mjs rafael && node tools/convert-animations.mjs
